children: SoSoValue data showed that SOL spot ETFs recorded a total net inflow of $13.77 million on September 23, U.S. Eastern Time. According to Odaily, Fidelity Solana Fund ETF (FSOL) led the group with a net inflow of $6.74 million, bringing its cumulative net inflow to $223 million.

Bitwise Solana Staking ETF (BSOL) followed with a net inflow of $3.94 million, and its cumulative net inflow reached $1.134 billion. As of press time, SOL spot ETFs had total net assets of $1.73 billion, a SOL net asset ratio of 2.58%, and cumulative net inflows of $1.486 billion.

title: SOL Spot ETFs Record $13.77 Million Net Inflow on September 23
